title: Terrible scam! Just a front for targeted ads
body: This app is a scam. There’s no real care for the user. It is full of spammy, AI generated content with spelling mistakes that once routines are added to your “routine” you can’t remove them. There’s no way to turn of app tracking, it’s a pure data mining scam, directly preying on people’s vulnerabilities. Would give 0 stars if I could. Definitely AVOID!
author: ellenmarie1708
